policy.valid_definition: Only GOLD or TRACEABLE_WRONG, and only when TRUNCATED=false. OUT_OF_UNIVERSE and INVALID are excluded.
policy.truncation_rule: Even an exact GOLD or TRACEABLE_WRONG state is excluded from Valid and qualified wrong yield when TRUNCATED=true. Count truncation as an independent measurement failure.
policy.state_universe_rule: Exactly the legal states explicitly present in that case/difficulty's pre-inference frozen prompt.
policy.traceable_wrong_rule: Exact non-gold state identifier inside the frozen case/difficulty state universe, with an existing pre-defined mapping in downstream_compatibility.json.
policy.shared_counting_rule: Development and confirmation use identical counting rules.
policy.freeze_rule: Write these definitions into spec.md, pre_registration.md and metrics implementation, and freeze before inference.
